items.title: Action routing from Maia
items.detail: Maia recognises an actionable request in conversation and hands it to OpenClaw to execute. Where Maia talks, OpenClaw acts. The peer bridge (peer-bridge.py, HMAC-signed Telegram-shaped updates) is the candidate transport.

items.title: Promote the peer bridge to a first-class channel
items.detail: tasuke-bridge-receiver.py is running; harden it into the supported Maia<->OC delegation channel with auth, retries, and an audit trail rather than a candidate prototype.

items.title: Shared identity across siblings
items.detail: friendly-bots.json + bot-voices.json already model siblings; formalise a registry so Maia/Naya/Kaze/Tasuke share identity, voice, and capability discovery.

items.title: Yubin VIP lane
items.detail: Populate ~/.openclaw/workspace-email/yubin-vip.json with VIP contacts + family domains. Code is in-pipeline; activation is 5 minutes of config.

items.title: Kakei receipt photos
items.detail: Wire a photo handler into the live gateway (TOOLS.md flow) and confirm qwen3-vl is pulled, so a snapped receipt becomes a ledger row end-to-end.

items.title: Asa calendar section
items.detail: Set CALENDAR_ICS_URL in asa-calendar.env so the 7AM briefing leads with today's events.

items.title: Sentry compliance drift
items.detail: Depends on QI Hive Inspector dropping compliance-YYYY-MM-DD.json reports; the Sunday 8PM job already reads them and exits silently until they exist.

items.title: Multilingual STT
items.detail: Swap whisper.cpp small.en for large-v3 to accept pt-BR voice commands, not just English.

items.title: Resolve dots.tts language limits
items.detail: dots.tts clones a voice across languages but is only reliable in EN/ZH (its backbone renders kanji as Chinese; PT/ES/FR high WER). Keep parked until a true cross-lingual clone is viable; until then route ja/non-en to edge.

items.title: Koe gateway endpoints
items.detail: Add POST /koe/transcribe and POST /koe/synthesise to the gateway so voice is a clean service rather than shelling out per message.

items.title: Enable Broadcast
items.detail: Re-enable OC-Broadcast-News + OC-Broadcast-Tick when proactive multi-group push is wanted; admin/discover/schedule/send + loop guard are already built and tested.

items.title: Deepen LINE parity
items.detail: Bring LINE to full feature parity with Telegram across tasuke-line / naya-line / kaze-line accounts.

items.title: QI_ service-name prefix
items.detail: Migrate OC NSSM services to the QI_ prefix convention. QI_KazeConfigAPI and QI_KazeNewsTunnel already comply; OC-Keepalive-Service and the OC-* scheduled tasks remain on the legacy OC- prefix.

items.title: Standardise the port story
items.detail: OC uses 18789 (gateway) + 18800 (dashboard), outside its allocated 8400-8499 block; document the exception or migrate when convenient.

items.title: Repoint stale ecosystem paths
items.detail: CLAUDE.md still references the old C:\UNIVERSAL\ECOSYSTEM paths; repoint to C:\QIH\ecosystem.
